messages:
tara: Morning — quick question about the orientation calendar. The invite I got says 9:00 AM PT but several new hires are CET. Is there a single recording link we should point them to?
onboarding-bot: Calendar event created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123 — recording will be attached to the event after the session.
sam: Hi @tara — session is 9:00 AM PT / 18:00 CET. We always post the recording to the event and a copy to Drive: /drive/onboarding/recordings.
ira: FYI APAC folks — we plan a repeat session for Asia-friendly hours (shorter Q&A) on Friday at 10:30 UTC+8. @mike scheduled that one, can you confirm availability?
mike: Confirmed. I created a replay event: https://meet.google.com/replay-xyz and added group new-hires@redwood.com. Invite sent and calendar shows both events.
jasmin: Thanks — small issue: when I download the .ics and import into Outlook the timezone shows wrong (it converts to GMT). Anyone else hit that?
sam: Jasmin — sorry about that. Outlook sometimes picks the host TZ. Workaround: download the .ics, import, then set the event timezone in Outlook to your local zone. I'll regenerate an .ics that fixes TZ metadata.
sam: (uploaded) New .ics here: https://storage.redwood.com/onboarding/ics/nh-orient-2024.ics — please re-download and re-import if you had issues.
tara: Will the slides/agenda be shared ahead of time so hires can skim before joining?
mike: Yes — slides + agenda are live: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/Onboard-Orientation-Decks — I put a short agenda and the expected run of show (90 mins incl Q&A).
ira: Managers — please RSVP in the event and list names of your direct reports joining so ops can provision accounts and badges after orientation.
jasmin: One more: are breakout rooms used? A few new hires will be on phones which sometimes causes problems.
mike: We will have 2 short breakout activities. If someone can’t join live we’ll 1) post the recording 2) host a weekly drop-in Q&A next Wednesday US-friendly time.
sam: Also adding a note in the calendar description about timestamps and recording chapters. We’ll include a quick table of timezone conversions and a reminder: "If you cannot attend live, watch the recording and join Q&A."
tara: Great — thanks everyone. If I hit calendar conflicts I’ll DM @sam to adjust. :thumbsup:
sam: Sounds good. I updated the calendar description with explicit timezones and a link to the recording folder: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123 — check the Description for links and the note about the APAC replay.
